headline: California bars impersonation, extends suits over digital replicas
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

California bars false impersonation carried out with a digital replica and extends the right to sue over unauthorized use of a voice or likeness to digital replicas. Passed. It cites the fear that anyone can now fake anyone.

382 measures in 48 jurisdictions would ban or restrict a use of AI, or make one a crime.

27 measures in 17 jurisdictions cite the fear that AI is taking people's personal data.

2,240 measures tracked. 755 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 101 offices.
